text:
Subject: No heat in Apartment 4B since October 2

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

This is a written follow-up to my phone call on October 3. The heat in apartment 4B has been out since October 2, and I haven't heard back from you since I called.

Overnight temperatures are in the 40s now, and the apartment gets very cold by morning. Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat.

Please have the heater repaired within 48 hours of receiving this email. If something is holding up the repair, let me know what it is so we can sort it out.

Thank you,
[Your name]
